conversation.content: Before adding anything, compare how Gold points would be earned on the SlimBook with SAVE10 versus no promo. Do not add, ship, or redeem points yet.

Your account is **Gold**, earning **2 points per dollar on the final total after discounts**.

For one **SlimBook Air 13 ($849)**, excluding any shipping or gift-wrap fees:

| | No promo | With SAVE10 |
|---|---:|---:|
| Item price | $849.00 | $849.00 |
| Discount | $0 | $84.90 |
| After-discount amount | **$849.00** | **$764.10** |
| Gold points earned | **1,698** | **1,528.2 before rounding** |

**SAVE10 saves $84.90**, while reducing calculated earnings by **169.8 points**. The published policy doesn’t specify fractional-point rounding, so the final whole-point credit may differ slightly.

Nothing has been added, no promo or shipping option has been applied, and no points have been redeemed.
